# The Boston Globe

> The Boston Globe is New England's trusted source for breaking news, sports coverage, investigative reporting, and regional analysis across Massachusetts and the broader region.

The Boston Globe provides comprehensive coverage of local, regional, and national news with particular focus on Boston-area sports teams, Massachusetts politics and education, and New England community events. The site serves as a primary news source for the Greater Boston area and Massachusetts.

## Key Topics

- Boston sports
- Massachusetts news
- Boston Red Sox
- New England Patriots
- Boston Bruins
- Breaking news
- Local politics
- MBTA and transportation
- Education and schools
- Investigative reporting
- New England weather
- Community events
- High school sports (MIAA)
- Women's sports
- Regional coverage

## News & Metro

- [The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com): Boston Globe homepage with trusted news, analysis, and regional coverage
- [Metro - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro): Metro section with breaking news, crime, politics, and community events
- [Politics - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/politics): State and national politics coverage with elections and legislation updates
- [Investigations | The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/investigations): Investigative reporting on corruption, government accountability, and scandals
- [The Great Divide - Race, class, and opportunity in Boston schools](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/education): Education coverage focusing on inequality, Boston schools, special education

## Boston Sports

- [Boston Globe sports news - NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL scores and schedule](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports): Sports section hub with scores, stats, standings for Boston teams
- [Boston Red Sox news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/baseball/redsox): Red Sox coverage including game reports, roster updates, player profiles
- [New England Patriots news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/football/patriots): Patriots news with draft analysis, free agency, coaching changes coverage
- [Boston Bruins news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/hockey/bruins): Bruins coverage including NHL scores, standings, and women's hockey
- [New England Revolution and Soccer - news, scores, and more](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/soccer/revolution): New England Revolution and soccer news including World Cup coverage

## College & Youth Sports

- [College sports news from the Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/colleges): College sports coverage including March Madness, NCAA tournament results
- [Massachusetts high school sports - MIAA news, scores, rankings from Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/high-schools): MIAA high school sports rankings, scores, schedules, and daily roundups
- [Women's sports news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/women): Women's sports coverage of PWHL, WNBA, NWSL, and professional leagues

## Regional Coverage

- [Around Massachusetts](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts): Massachusetts regional news covering communities across the state
- [Cambridge & Somerville News | The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts/cambridge-somerville): Cambridge and Somerville local news, development, and community events
- [Transportation - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/transportation): Boston transportation news including MBTA, Logan Airport, traffic alerts

## Reference & Resources

- [Weather news and resources for Boston, Mass., and New England - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/weather): Boston and New England weather forecasts, alerts, and storm updates
- [Boston sports TV listings from the Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/tv-radio): Boston sports TV schedule, channels, and radio station listings
- [Obituaries - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/obituaries): Obituaries and death notices of notable individuals and community members
